findings.problem: PMS account totals included provisioned invitations
findings.fix: Exclude invited AccessPolicy identities; retain provisioned account metric separately

findings.problem: Active definitions differed; on-leave was inferred as total minus active
findings.fix: Share distinct employee IDs and explicit Active/Probation/On Leave statuses

findings.problem: HR report counts included deleted or other-organization records for global administrators
findings.fix: Explicit organization and employee grant predicates; legacy reporting dependency

findings.problem: Multi-organization membership totals could count the same user more than once
findings.fix: Unique identity sets across administrable organizations; label global scope

findings.problem: Cross-organization workspace memberships or archived workspaces could affect project totals
findings.fix: Intersect project permission query with current organization and live workspace

findings.problem: Done-only completion and incomplete terminal states produced inconsistent overdue counts
findings.fix: Shared completed/terminal states; full-query status chart; recipient rows counted separately

findings.problem: Selected batches only used a primary project; cancelled recipients affected totals
findings.fix: Use all assigned batch project IDs and uncancelled recipient executions; label assignments

findings.problem: Approval summary was derived after per-source 200-row limits
findings.fix: SQL union aggregates before paginating selected IDs

findings.problem: HR home and pending counts used capped employee/request previews
findings.fix: Full-query counts and explicitly bounded joiner/exit previews

findings.problem: CRM cards counted or summed the first 100 fetched rows
findings.fix: Full-query period statistics plus matching paginated worklists

findings.problem: CRM dashboard included lead archive operating-state records
findings.fix: Canonical scoped query excludes archived lead operating state

findings.problem: CRM/Sales/Analytics summed unlike currencies
findings.fix: Group by explicit currency; scalar unavailable for mixed/unknown units; no conversion invented

findings.problem: Historical profitability snapshots were summed as current profit
findings.fix: Latest stored snapshot per authorized engagement; disclose missing currency history

findings.problem: Export reused the preview page clamp and could mark an incomplete file completed
findings.fix: Export full matching rows up to explicit synchronous limit; fail clearly beyond it

findings.problem: Cross-module reports capped deals at 100 and inferred profit via customer
findings.fix: Count/page all visible deals, batch real order/invoice links, decline inferred margin

findings.problem: Personal notification APIs had divergent tenant filters
findings.fix: Shared personal/organization predicate for unread, list and group summary

findings.problem: Tenant changes and mutations could retain unrelated statistics cache entries
findings.fix: Cancel/clear on identity/organization/grant changes and invalidate statistics on successful mutations

findings.problem: Unimplemented project metrics used numeric zero
findings.fix: Return explicit unavailable values and metadata instead of fabricated zero

findings.problem: Integrated Inventory payment total was the combined 100+100 preview length
findings.fix: Count complete source queries and expose returned_count independently

findings.problem: Automation organization helper ignored canonical request/persisted tenant context
findings.fix: Reuse tenant resolver and explicitly scope log/approval totals

findings.problem: A GET aging report overwrote a currency-less customer aging cache
findings.fix: Calculate read-only customer/currency groups and business-date age buckets
